system.description:
ATTACK FLOURISH

Action 1 AP

You make a melee attack against your target with a -2-circumstance penalty. If the attack inflicts damage, it is classed as a feint against your target using your total Attack Roll as the Feint DC.

Automated: press Use while in Drunken Stance: 1 AP and a melee Strike at −2 circumstance. If it deals damage, your attack total stands as your Feint check against the target's Feint DC (the higher of its Level DC and its Sense Motive DC, Hard), and the Feint's own result applies: a Success leaves the target flat-footed (Graham's B6-3).
